title: Chipsoft compatibility guidance
source: OpenSAAB-T2/src/adapter_compatibility.rs; passive advice used by the shared crash formatter; Android is a thin UI binding
rules: Show observed model/firmware and the tested Pro1.5.2 identity separately. Missing evidence remains unknown.
Recommend the Pro update package only for observed Pro firmware with an unambiguous numeric version older than1.5.2.
A matching1.5.2 rejection is not evidence of outdated firmware. Newer/unknown firmware requires evidence rather than a downgrade instruction.
Mid/Lite are model-support gaps; a firmware update never grants capabilities.
Open the fixed official link only after an explicit tap following cleanup; never run an updater, flash, restart, upload or retry automatically.
Retain the first failure category, independent cleanup and bounded local identity; exclude raw identity/serials.
Android uses direct USB and does not load the Windows J2534 driver.
